metadata.title: The 7th-Night Karma of the Scheming Heiress
metadata.subtitle: My adopted sister stole my identity and billionaire fiancé—forgetting the 7th-night spirit return after Grandfather’s funeral.

nodes.text: 11:25 PM · Seven nights after Grandfather’s funeral. Rain drums against the conservatory roof while Natalie moves her suitcases into your master wing.
The hospital archive just confirmed I’m Grandfather’s biological granddaughter—and you’re the adopted charity case, {{player_name}}. Pack up by midnight.
You forged a 24-year-old birth registry the week Grandfather passed? You really picked tonight—the 7th night—to sleep in his master wing?
Natalie showed me the stamped clinic certificate, {{player_name}}. The engagement contract is with the true heir of Sterling House—I need space to think.

nodes.prompt: Mr. Chen—who served Grandfather for forty years—quietly texts you:

options.label: Warn Natalie not to lock Grandfather’s study
options.player_reply_text: Tonight is Grandfather’s 7th night, Natalie. If you leave the master wing lights off and stay in my bed, don’t scream when his cane taps down the hall.

options.label: Ask Mr. Chen about Grandfather’s cane
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Chen, did anyone move Grandfather’s ebony walking cane from the umbrella stand?

nodes.text: Pathetic superstition! Grandfather is six feet under and Lucas is mine now. Goodnight, impostor.
It was bolted inside the glass memorial case, Miss {{player_name}}—yet five minutes ago the glass swung open and the cane vanished!
11:59 PM · Downstairs, the ancestral pendulum clock strikes twelve... then strikes a thirteenth time.

nodes.headline: The Thirteenth Chime
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The green desk lamp clicks on inside Grandfather’s locked oak study.

nodes.text: 12:04 AM · From the garden courtyard, Mr. Chen spots a warm amber glow spilling from Grandfather’s sealed second-floor study.
Miss {{player_name}}, I hold the only brass key to the Master’s study—yet his reading lamp is on and the scent of his pipe tobacco is drifting into the hall.
Stop messing with the circuit breaker, {{player_name}}!! Wait—why is the rotary telephone in Grandfather’s study ringing my cell phone?!
That landline was disconnected three days ago, Natalie. Are you sure you’re looking at the right number?

nodes.prompt: Natalie accidentally hits speakerphone—a slow tapping echoes over the line:

options.label: Ask what the voice just whispered
options.player_reply_text: Speak up, Natalie. What date did Grandfather’s landline just read out loud?

options.label: Tell Lucas to remember that exact date
options.player_reply_text: Write down October 14, 2001, Lucas. That’s the day Natalie’s real mother paid a clerk to swap two hospital folders.

nodes.text: October 14, 2001!! That’s—that’s the night the midwife retired—how could a disconnected phone know that date?!
Wait... Natalie, your certificate says you were born October 14—why are you shaking like a leaf?!

nodes.headline: Tap... Tap... Tap...
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Heavy ebony-cane footsteps begin moving down the marble corridor toward Natalie’s door.

nodes.text: 12:19 AM · TAP. TAP. TAP. The unmistakable rhythm of Grandfather’s ebony cane echoes along the second-floor marble gallery.
Lucas, get up here RIGHT NOW!! The footsteps stopped right outside the master bedroom door!!
Sir Lucas, do not touch the upstairs switchboard. The temperature outside the master suite just plummeted twelve degrees.
You’re sleeping in my room wearing my mother’s silk robe, Natalie. Grandfather always knew who really belonged in this house.

nodes.prompt: Natalie pushes a vanity chair against the oak door:

options.label: Ask about the birthmark she hid
options.player_reply_text: Grandfather wrote in his diary that his true granddaughter has a crescent birthmark below her left collarbone. Show Lucas yours, Natalie.

options.label: Have Mr. Chen pull the 3AM hallway cam
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Chen, check the hallway security monitor right now. Send Lucas what is standing outside that door.

nodes.text: I had it lasered off in high school!! Stop making up lies—wait, why is the chair sliding away from the door by itself?!
Pulling the live frame now, Miss {{player_name}}! My hands are shaking—you need to see this.

nodes.headline: Outside the Master Wing
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The hallway camera captures a familiar silhouette leaning on an ebony cane.

nodes.text: 12:31 AM · Mr. Chen uploads the security snapshot from the second-floor gallery straight into the family chat.

nodes.caption: Look at the gallery shadow, Sir Lucas. The Master has returned on his 7th night—and he is pointing straight at the master suite.

nodes.text: My God... that’s his exact posture. Natalie, if you lied about that birth certificate, tell me right now before I lose my mind!
I didn’t forge anything!! Wait—my jewelry box just popped open and every diamond bracelet I took from {{player_name}} is ice-cold!!

nodes.prompt: Grandfather’s ebony cane taps three sharp warning beats against the door:

options.label: Tell Natalie to open Grandfather’s safe
options.player_reply_text: Grandfather already ran a private DNA test on both of us last winter, Natalie. It’s sitting inside his locked study desk.

options.label: Notice her accidental slip of the tongue
options.player_reply_text: Did you just hear that, Lucas? She bribed a clinic manager to destroy Grandfather’s private DNA sample.

nodes.text: That’s impossible!! The clinic manager swore he destroyed Grandfather’s winter blood sample!!
Natalie!! You paid someone to destroy my grandfather’s medical test?!

nodes.headline: The Slip of the Tongue
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The study door unlocks by itself—revealing the truth Grandfather hid in his fountain pen.

nodes.text: 12:46 AM · Mr. Chen leads you and Lucas to Grandfather’s study. The brass deadbolt has already slid open; on the green blotter lies a sealed ivory envelope.
Look at the desk, Miss {{player_name}}. Grandfather’s ebony cane is resting neatly across the ivory envelope—pointing right at your name.
It’s a duplicate DNA report from an independent Swiss lab—not the local clinic Natalie bribed. 99.998% direct match to Grandfather.
And look at the second sheet... Natalie’s real parents aren’t even distant relatives—she was brought in from an agency six years ago!

nodes.prompt: Down the hall, Natalie pounds on her bedroom door, trapped inside:

options.label: Send her a photo of the Swiss report
options.player_reply_text: Game over, Natalie. Grandfather sent a backup DNA sample to Zurich six months ago.

options.label: Check Grandfather’s hidden ledger
options.player_reply_text: Wait—there’s a bank-routing slip clipped to the back of the Swiss report. Someone wired $200,000 out of Grandfather’s medical account last Tuesday.

nodes.text: No!! Let me out of this room—the portraits on the wall are all staring straight at me!!
Tuesday was the night before the Master passed! Miss Natalie was the only person alone in his hospital room that evening!

nodes.headline: The Tuesday Night Withdrawal
nodes.teaser_text: Next: You confront Natalie about what really happened in Grandfather’s hospital room.

nodes.text: 1:05 AM · The master bedroom lock snaps open. Natalie stumbles out, clutching her throat as icy air trails behind her.
Forget the fake birth certificate for a second, Natalie. Why did $200,000 leave Grandfather’s account while you were watching him on Tuesday night?
He gave me his tablet PIN to pay the private nurse!! Stop looking at me like that, Lucas!
If they check the hospital nurse-call log and see I muted Grandfather’s monitor while copying his thumbprint, I’m finished!
YOU MUTED HIS HEART MONITOR TO STEAL HIS THUMBPRINT?! Natalie, you monster!!

nodes.prompt: Natalie lunges for the staircase, terrified of Lucas’s rage:

options.label: Block the stairs and call homicide detectives
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Chen, lock the front gates and call the police right now. Tell them it’s suspected elder negligence and grand theft.

options.label: Watch Grandfather’s cane trip her path
options.player_reply_text: You aren’t taking a single step down those stairs until you answer for Tuesday night.

nodes.text: Already on the line with Inspector Walsh, Miss {{player_name}}. Patrol cars are five minutes out.
Natalie’s heel catches on nothing—she crashes onto the landing as the heavy ebony cane rolls neatly to a stop in front of her face.

nodes.headline: Stopped at the Landing
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Natalie breaks down and reveals who sold her the forged hospital registry.

nodes.text: 1:24 AM · Trapped on the grand landing with police sirens approaching outside, Natalie sobs uncontrollably.
I didn’t hurt Grandfather!! I swear I only muted the chime for ninety seconds while he was asleep so I could unlock his bank app—the doctor was right outside!
And who did you wire that $200,000 to? The clinic manager who forged your fake birth certificate?
Half went to the clinic clerk—and the other half went to Lucas’s own step-uncle, Gerald! He told me how to switch the hospital archive!

nodes.prompt: Lucas stares in shock at the mention of his step-uncle:

options.label: Demand the bank transfer proof
options.player_reply_text: Unlock your banking app and send the wire receipt to Mr. Chen right now, Natalie.

options.label: Ask why Gerald wanted me replaced
options.player_reply_text: Because I refused to merge Sterling House with Gerald’s failing logistics group last month, didn’t I?

nodes.text: Received! Downloading the full wire trace for Inspector Walsh right now.
Gerald swore to me he barely knew Natalie! He was trying to put a puppet heir in your chair to drain Sterling House!

nodes.headline: The Puppet Master
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Mr. Chen pulls the bank transfer screenshot—sealing both conspirators’ fates.

nodes.text: 1:42 AM · Police secure the foyer while Mr. Chen verifies the bank-transfer screenshot from Natalie’s phone.

nodes.caption: Confirmed, Miss {{player_name}}. Every dollar matches Gerald’s shell account and the forged hospital clerk’s bribe.

nodes.text: Inspector Walsh just issued a warrant for Gerald too. {{player_name}}, I let a forged piece of paper make me doubt you tonight. I don’t deserve your forgiveness.
You’re right, Lucas. When things got ugly, you asked for "space" instead of standing beside your fiancée.

nodes.prompt: Officers lead Natalie past you in handcuffs toward the front door:

options.label: Tell her the truth always surfaces
options.player_reply_text: Grandfather treated you like family for six years, Natalie. You threw it all away out of greed.

options.label: Recover Mother’s silk robe and jewels
options.player_reply_text: Officer, please log the diamond bracelet and my mother’s emerald brooch from her suitcase before she leaves.

nodes.text: I’m sorry, {{player_name}}... tell Grandfather I’m sorry.
Every single heirloom has been recovered and inventoried safely, Miss {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: The Warrant Executed
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Gerald is arrested at his private club—and Grandfather’s estate lawyer arrives at dawn.

nodes.text: 2:50 AM · Gerald is booked at downtown headquarters. In the quiet drawing room, Lucas places the velvet ring box gently on the coffee table.
I know I broke your trust when I hesitated tonight, {{player_name}}. If you want to cancel the engagement, I’ll sign the release without taking a dime.
For what it is worth, Miss {{player_name}}, the Master’s will gives YOU sole discretion over the engagement alliance and 100% of Sterling House.

nodes.prompt: Lucas waits quietly for your decision:

options.label: Pause the engagement until he earns trust
options.player_reply_text: Keep the ring for now, Lucas. If you want a future with me, start over from square one—as equals, not a business contract.

options.label: End the engagement cleanly tonight
options.player_reply_text: Let’s end the engagement cleanly, Lucas. Sterling House doesn’t need a merger—it needs a leader who never wavers.

nodes.text: I’ll gladly start at square one, {{player_name}}. However long it takes.
I respect your choice, {{player_name}}. You truly are your grandfather’s heir.

nodes.headline: The Ebony Cane Returns
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Before sunrise, you return Grandfather’s cane to the memorial case.

nodes.text: 4:55 AM · The rain stops and pale silver mist lifts from the bonsai garden. You lift Grandfather’s ebony cane from his study desk.
The memorial glass case closed smoothly, Miss {{player_name}}. Look—the faint scent of his pipe tobacco just faded into the morning air.
He only came back to make sure nobody stole my birthright. Goodbye, Grandfather.

nodes.prompt: You switch off the green reading lamp in his study:

options.label: Leave fresh jasmine tea by his portrait
options.player_reply_text: One last warm cup before dawn, Grandfather. Rest peacefully.

options.label: Open the curtains to welcome the dawn
options.player_reply_text: A new morning for Sterling House. I won’t let you down.

nodes.text: The ancestral pendulum clock ticks softly and steadily—normal once again.
First rays of amber sunlight brush across the oak bookshelves.

nodes.headline: Dawn in the Bonsai Garden
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning sunlight warms Grandfather’s prized pines as the true heiress steps forward.

nodes.text: 7:50 AM · Crisp golden sunlight sparkles on the dew-covered bonsai pines Grandfather tended for fifty years.
Good morning, Chairwoman {{player_name}}. The family attorneys have registered the Swiss DNA record and frozen Gerald’s corporate ties.
Thank you, Mr. Chen. Let’s water Grandfather’s pines before the 9:00 AM board briefing.

nodes.prompt: You lift the copper watering can in the warm morning breeze:

options.label: Smile and tend the pines peacefully
options.player_reply_text: Everything is finally right where it belongs.

options.label: Establish a scholarship for orphans
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Chen, let’s turn the recovered funds into an annual scholarship in Grandfather’s name.

nodes.text: Sunlight warms your shoulders as songbirds wake in the courtyard—the 7th night has passed into a bright new era.
Mr. Chen wipes a proud tear as morning bells ring clear across the sunlit estate.

nodes.headline: Heir of Sterling House
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The 7th-Night Karma of the Scheming Heiress"! Explore more karma stories.
